candidates.title: File:The Statue of Eyo.jpg
candidates.author: Aimee.shot.it
candidates.description: Eyo is the name of a type of statue that is found in the culture of the Yoruba people of southwestern Nigeria. The Eyo statue is typically a tall, slender figure with a mask-like face and flowing robes. They are often displayed in pairs, representing male and female figures. The Eyo statue has great cultural significance, and is often seen as a symbol of fertility, prosperity, and protection. The statues are also believed to have spiritual powers and are said to represent the ancestors of the Yoruba people. In addition to their religious significance, Eyo statues are also admired for their artistic beauty and craftsmanship.
